data.value: 1. Retrieving Data (SELECT) The SELECT statement retrieves specific rows and columns from a table. Example: SELECT ID, Salary FROM SalesStaff 2. Calculated Columns & Aliases You can create new temporary columns from mathematical operations and rename them using 'AS' (an alias). Example: hrsWorked * Rate AS payAmount 3. Filtering Rows (WHERE) The WHERE clause selects or filters out rows based on a specific condition. Example: WHERE payAmount > 1000 4. Sorting Records (ORDER BY) The ORDER BY clause dictates the order in which rows appear, defaulting to ascending or using 'DESC' for descending order (high to low).
